In every round $t$, the algorithm first observes context ${\cxL}_t(a) \in \domain^{m}$ for every arm $a$, and then chooses an arm $a_t \in [K]$, and finally observes a reward $r_t(a_t) \in [0,1]$ and a $d$-dimensional consumption vector $\cv_t(a_t) \in [0,1]^d$... ensuring that the total consumption does not exceed budget, i.e., $\sum_t \cv_t(a_t) \le B\ones$.

algorithms.name: Algorithm 1: Algorithm for linCBwK with given Z (optimistic confidence ellipsoids + OMD dual multipliers)
Algorithm 2: Algorithm for linCBwK with Z computation

symbols.OPT: value of the optimal static policy (benchmark)

conditions: B > m T^{3/4} (paper's m = context dimension d)

source.label: th:general
source.quote: There is an algorithm for \linCBwK such that if $B>m T^{3/4}$, then with probability at least $1-\delta,$ \[ \regret(T) = O\left( (\tfrac \OPT B + 1){m} \sqrt{{\ln(\di T/\delta) \ln(T)}{T}} \right).\]

results.notes: Paper's m (context dimension) mapped to d; paper's d (number of resources) declared d_res. Algorithm assumed to be Algorithm 2 (with Z computation), per Theorem 4.

symbols.OPT: value of the optimal static policy (benchmark)

conditions: A parameter Z with OPT/B <= Z <= O(OPT/B + 1) is given to the algorithm (Assumption 1)

source.label: th:coreAlgo
source.quote: Given a $Z$ as per Assumption \ref{assum:Z}, Algorithm \ref{algo:coreAlgo} achieves the following bounds, given that $\regOCO(T)$ is the regret of the \OCO algorithm, with probability $1-\delta$: $$ \regret(T) \le O\left( (\tfrac \OPT B + 1) m \sqrt{T \ln(\di T/\delta) \ln(T)} \right).$$

results.notes: Requires knowledge of Z (a function of OPT), recorded as condition.

symbols.OPT: value of the optimal static policy (benchmark)
symbols.T_0: number of initial exploration rounds used to estimate Z

conditions: B > max{2 T_0, m T / sqrt(T_0)}
tuning: twice the Z given by Corollary 4

source.label: th:largeK
source.quote: Using Algorithm \ref{algo:linearZ} with $T_0$ such that $B> \max\{2T_0, mT/\sqrt{T_0}\}$, and twice the $Z$ given by Corollary \ref{cor:packingZest}, we get a high probability regret bound of \[\textstyle \tilde{O}\left(\left(\frac{\OPT}{B} +1\right) \left({T_0} + {m}{\sqrt{T}}\right)\right).\]

symbols.OPT: value of the optimal static policy (benchmark)

tuning: twice the Z given by Corollary 4

source.label: th:largeK
source.quote: In particular, using $T_0= \sqrt{T}$, and assuming $B>m T^{3/4}$ gives a regret bound of \[\textstyle \tilde{O}\left(\left(\frac{\OPT}{B} +1\right) {m}{\sqrt{T}}\right).\]
